overview:
[Tenable.io][1] is the cloud platform that provides a rich capability for discovery, assessment, reporting, and prioritization of vulnerabilities across systems and services. It enhances visibility with asset discovery and helps organizations manage their security posture effectively.

The Tenable.io integration collects the following types of logs:

- **Activity**: This endpoint contains information of user actions, system events, scans, and security control tasks, such as managing permissions, assigning roles, and handling security events.
- **Vulnerability**: This endpoint contains information on vulnerabilities and the associated vulnerable assets.

This integration collects logs from the sources listed above and sends them to Datadog.

[1]: https://www.tenable.com/
setup:
### Generate API credentials in Tenable.io

1. Log in to [Tenable.io][4] with an account that has the required role based on your use case:
    - **Activity Logs**: Requires the Administrator user role.
    - **Vulnerability Logs**: Requires the Basic user role.
2. Click the profile icon and select **My Profile**.
3. Navigate to the **API Keys** section.
4. Click the **Generate** button in the lower right-corner of the page.
5. Review the message in the warning dialog box and click **Continue** to generate the **access Key** and **secret Key**.

### Connect your Tenable.io account to Datadog

1. Add your access key and secret key
    |Parameters|Description|
    |--------------------|--------------------|
    |Access Key|The access key for your Tenable.io account.|
    |Secret Key|The secret key for your Tenable.io account.|
    |Collect activity logs| Controls the collection of activity logs from Tenable.io.   
 Enabled by default.|
    |Collect vulnerability logs| Controls the collection of vulnerability logs from Tenable.io.   
 Enabled by default.|
2. Click the **Save** button to save your settings.

[4]: https://cloud.tenable.com/tio/app.html#/login

monitors.title: Automatic asset age out activity detected
monitors.description: Asset age-out refers to the automatic deletion of assets that have not been scanned within a specified number of days. This monitor tracks asset age out activity to notify the deletion of the asset and its related information including vulnerabilities.

monitors.title: Multiple asset deletion activities detected
monitors.description: Asset deletion refers to the removal of assets from the system. This monitor tracks asset deletion activity to notify unauthorized or accidental deletions, ensuring that critical assets are not removed without proper oversight.

monitors.title: Multiple user impersonation activities detected
monitors.description: User impersonation occurs when one user stimulates being logged in as another user. This monitor tracks impersonation activities by a user and helps prevent any misuse of the impersonation feature.
